diagnosis: The account is on the 'startup' plan tier, which does not include the audit log feature. The 403 error is expected behavior when calling an endpoint for a feature not entitled to the current plan.
reply: Thank you for contacting support. The 403 error you are receiving from the audit log endpoint indicates that this feature is not currently available on your account's plan tier. According to our documentation, audit logs are included only on standard and premium support tiers, while your account is currently on the startup tier. To access this feature, you would need to upgrade your plan.
